title: 第7章 再入星槎第8章 事变
content_zh:
不过，所谓“知识有毒”
的根源又是什么呢？是这个世界独有的特点，还是其他什么外因？
比如我“见”
过的那些世界之外的不可名状物？
它们不想这个世界发展出太多的高端战力或前沿科技，所以才让“知识”
有了“毒”
赵晨的思绪渐渐发散开来，一时间越飘越远。
见他陷入沉思，黄显钧馆主可想不到自家这个小弟子会去思索一些要命的玩意儿，只以为他对于《金楼玉室十二重门行气秘录》并不满意，所以再次开口强调道：
“‘上古云篆’虽然危险，但这本真气境界可以修行的秘录依旧价值不菲……再加上后面附的那段翻译和暗语注解，如果拿到修行者的聚会中去交易，至少也能卖出500贯！”
说到对上古云篆的翻译和注解时，黄显钧馆主的语气里微微有些得意。
听这口吻，你之前说的所谓“解文名家”
该不会就是您老自己吧？回过神的赵晨忍不住在心里吐槽了一句。
这便宜师傅虽然现在落魄，仿佛只是个会一两手绝活的普通武者，但据其刚才自述，再加上昨天与他比武的“黄衫铳士”
商业互吹时的佐证，可以知道这位“一镖震赤金”
的“金镖客”
出身一个叫“禹王宗”
的宗门，且原本至少也是“通玄”
第三境“法力”
境界的高人，只是不知因为什么被废除了功力，逐出师门了而已。
他虽然功力尽失，但境界可能还在，所以才有能力解读出上古云篆的内容？

“另外，如果这本秘录真的能卖出500贯，那当真价值不菲……毕竟我这个身体的便宜爹，经商一年的利润明面上也就500到800贯。
“这便宜师傅虽然又自恋，又爱显摆，但本事还是有的。”
赵晨暗暗思忖道。
在如今的大夏，1000文钱为1贯，而最便宜的红黍米每斤只要两到三文，这其中还大部分是运输和储存的费用……而一贯钱的购买力相当于八九百rmb了，甚至更多。
至于红黍米，则是一种官方提供的此界特有粮食，口感很差，也没什么营养，但勉强可以填饱肚子……它的好处在于价格极为低廉，且官府几乎能无限量供应……
但常吃红黍米的人似乎都活不长久，绝大部分都活不到四十，一旦习武还死的更快，就连山贼土匪抢劫都不会抢这种粮食。
赵晨再次收回发散得有些远的思绪，合上手里的秘录，向黄显钧行了一礼道：“多谢师傅赐法。”
见小徒弟终于认可了《金楼玉室十二重门行气秘录》的价值，黄显钧也暗暗松了口气，笑着说道：
“你在修行上还有什么问题吗？今天既然有暇，为师我索性一并解答了。”
赵晨想到那个进入“大日星槎”
的必要条件，试探着问道：“师傅，什么是‘入静’？”
“‘入静’啊……如果是仓儿问这个，那我一定骂他好高骛远。”
黄显钧闻言再次端起了架子，在看了眼三弟子冯仓的同时，捋着胡须道，“但你不同，作为修道种子，你询问‘入静’事宜，倒是正当其时。”
见此，赵晨很识趣地接话道：“为什么？”
黄显钧却没有直接回答，而是话锋一转，说起了别的：
content_en:
However, the so-called "knowledge is poisonous"
What is the root cause? Is it a unique characteristic of this world, or is it due to other external factors?
For example, I "see"
Those indescribable things outside the world that we have lived in?
They don’t want the world to develop too many high-end combat capabilities or cutting-edge technologies, so they let “knowledge”
With "poison"
Zhao Chen's thoughts gradually spread out, drifting further and further away.
Seeing that he was deep in thought, Hall Master Huang Xianjun never thought that his young disciple would think about something fatal. He thought that he was not satisfied with the "Secret Records of the Twelve Gates of the Golden House and the Jade Chamber", so he spoke again and emphasized:
"Although the 'Ancient Cloud Seal' is dangerous, this secret record that can be practiced in the realm of true energy is still valuable... plus the translation and code annotation attached at the end, if it is traded in a gathering of practitioners, at least 500 seals can be sold!"
When talking about the translation and annotation of ancient Yunzhuan script, the owner of the library, Huang Xianjun, sounded slightly proud.
Listening to this tone, the so-called "famous interpreter" you mentioned before
Could it be your old self? Zhao Chen, who came back to his senses, couldn't help but complain in his heart.
Although this cheap master is now in dire straits and seems to be just an ordinary warrior who knows one or two unique skills, according to what he just said, plus the "yellow-shirted gunslinger" who competed with him yesterday
From the evidence of business bragging, we can know that this "one dart shakes red gold"
"Golden Escort"
Born in a family called "Yu Wangzong"
sect, and was originally at least "tongxuan"
The third realm "mana"
The masters of the realm have just lost their skills and been expelled from the school for unknown reasons.
Although he has lost all his skills, his realm may still be there, so he is able to decipher the contents of ancient cloud seal scripts?
"In addition, if this secret book can really sell 500 guan, it will be really worth a lot of money... After all, I am a cheap dad, and my profit from doing business in one year is only 500 to 800 guan.
“Although this cheap master is narcissistic and loves to show off, he still has some skills. "
Zhao Chen thought secretly.
In today's Daxia, 1,000 Wen is equivalent to 1 Guan, and the cheapest red millet rice only costs 2 to 3 Wen per catty. Most of this is the cost of transportation and storage... and the purchasing power of a Guan's money is equivalent to eight or nine hundred RMB, or even more.
As for red millet, it is a unique grain provided by the government. It tastes very bad and has no nutrition, but it can barely fill the stomach... Its advantage is that the price is extremely low, and the government can supply it in almost unlimited quantities...
But people who often eat red millet rice don't seem to live long, and most of them don't live to be forty. Once they practice martial arts, they die faster, and even bandits and bandits will not snatch this kind of food.
Zhao Chen once again retracted his thoughts that had strayed a little far away, closed the secret record in his hand, saluted Huang Xianjun and said, "Thank you, master, for the teaching. "
Seeing that his young apprentice finally recognized the value of "The Secret Record of the Twelve Doors of the Golden House and the Jade Chamber", Huang Xianjun also secretly breathed a sigh of relief and said with a smile:
"Do you have any other problems with your practice? Since I have free time today, I will answer them all as a teacher. "
Zhao Chen thought about the one who entered the "Big Sun Star Cha"
necessary conditions, and asked tentatively: "Master, what is 'entering tranquility'? "
"'Be still'... If Cang'er asked this, I would definitely scold him for being too ambitious. "
Hearing this, Huang Xianjun put on airs again. While looking at the third disciple Feng Cang, he stroked his beard and said, "But you are different. As a seed of cultivation, it is the right time for you to ask about 'entering tranquility'. "
Seeing this, Zhao Chen answered wisely: "Why? "
Huang Xianjun did not answer directly, but changed the topic and talked about something else:
